headline: Enabling encryption on an existing RDS instance requires destroying and recreating the database—this will cause downtime and data loss if not migrated carefully. The PR description misses this critical detail.

findings.evidence_ref: storage_encrypted changed from false to true in data_stores.tf. AWS RDS requires database replacement to enable encryption on an existing instance.
findings.explanation: Terraform will destroy and recreate this production database to apply the encryption setting. This will cause downtime and data loss unless you perform a backup-and-restore migration first. The PR description treats this as a simple one-line change, which is dangerous.
